as_told.title: Buffalo Soldiers as Freemasons and the 'as above, so below' inscription

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes an old engraving reading 'as above, so below', a saying from old mystical traditions, found at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events. He says nobody knows who carved it, but suggests it may be the work of Augustus Walley, a famed Buffalo Soldier, as the Black US Army troops of the 1800s were called, who won the Medal of Honor. In a later episode he leaves out Walley's name and instead points out that the Buffalo Soldiers were Freemasons, a secret fraternal society, hinting that the carving holds hidden knowledge about the place.
